title: Employee onboarding
goal: Show HR and IT parallel onboarding work.

rubric.must: Employee and Company are separate pools with message flows crossing between them.
Parallel gateways visibly split account creation and equipment issue then join before Onboarded.
Company visibly has HR and IT lanes.
Offer accepted is a start event and Onboarded is an end event.
Welcome is a dashed message flow to Employee.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 satisfies all five rules, while image 2 omits the Employee pool and message flows and places account creation and equipment preparation sequentially rather than in parallel.
